title: An add that wraps at 32 bits
starter:
let add32 (a : int) (b : int) : int =
  a + b
hints: `a + b` is right until the sum leaves the 32-bit range. The sum has to pass through `Int32` on its way out.
Follow the three moves of the worked example: move both numbers in with `Int32.of_int`, add with `Int32.add`, move the answer out with `Int32.to_int`.
explain: The reference is `Int32.to_int (Int32.add (Int32.of_int a) (Int32.of_int b))`. `Int32.add` keeps only the low 32 bits of the sum, so 2147483647 + 1 comes out as -2147483648, the way the course's `add` must.
